label: Live
definition: Open for participation, or still running under existing contracts, at the date given in status_as_of.

label: Planned
definition: Announced by the operator and in design or implementation, but not yet open to participants.

label: Trial
definition: Running as a time-limited trial or innovation project.

label: Suspended
definition: Temporarily not procuring or not operating; the operator expects to resume it.

label: Closed
definition: Permanently ended or replaced. The record is kept for history.
